rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTIONS 22, 24, 25, 27, 28, 29, 30, 32, 34, 37, 38, 39, 42, 51, 52, 54, 56, 57, 73, 108, 121, 122, 123, 174, 176, 179, 181, 182, 183, 184, 185, 186, 187, 188, 189, 190, 191, 194, 195, 196, 197, 198, AND 199; AND REPEALING SECTIONS 127, 175, 177, 178, 180, 192, AND 193; ALL UNDER REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8424, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE OF 1997,  AS AMENDED, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Amending Sections 22, 24, 25, 27, 28, 29, 32, 34, 37, 38, 39, 42, 51, 52, 54, 56, 57, 73, 108, 121, 122, 123, 174, 176, 179, 181, 182, 183, 184, 185, 186, 187, 195, 198, And 199; And Repealing Sections 127, 175, 177, 178, 180, 192, And 193; All Under Republic Act No. 8424, Otherwise Known As The National Internal Revenue Code Of 1997, As Amended, And For Other Purposes
rows.abstract:
Covers the fourth package of the Administration's Comprehensive Tax Reform Program, making capital income taxes and financial intermediary taxes simpler, fairer and more efficient in order to fuel and 
direct the movement of capital rightly to where they are most needed, so that higher, sustainable, and more inclusive growth can be achieved.

Proposes reforms on the following: a) tax rates on interest income and on interests, dividends, and capital gains; b) GRT rate for all Financial Intermediaries, excluding premium on insurance; c) Pre-need, pension, life and HMO insurance/non-life insurance premium tax rates; d) capital market development (IPO tax removal); e) DST of the financial sector; and f) adoption of regionally competitive tax system comparable to those neighboring ASEAN nations and their best practices.
rows.alias_name: Passive Income and Financial Intermediary Taxation Act
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2019-09-09, transmitted to the Senate on 2019-09-10 and received by the Senate on 2019-09-10

rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTING REFORMS IN REAL PROPERTY VALUATION AND ASSESSMENT IN THE PHILIPPINES, REORGANIZING THE BUREAU OF LOCAL GOVERNMENT FINANCE, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Proposes to:  a) establish and maintain valuation standards in appraising lands, buildings, machinery and 
other real properties; b) provide a comprehensive and up-to-date electronic database of all related transactions (sale, exchange, lease, mortgage, donation, and others, and on the cost of construction or renovation of buildings and other structures, and on prices of machinery); c) ensure transparency to protect the public and develop confidence in the work of appraisers and assessors.

Tasks the Bureau of Local Government Finance (BLGF), through the Real Property Valuation Service
(RPVS) to lead and manage the implementation in the development, adoption, and maintenance of 
valuation standards consistent with generally accepted valuation standards, regulations and 
specifications for real property appraisal used for tax and other purposes.

rows.title_full: AN ACT SIMPLIFYING THE PROCEDURE IN THE DISPOSITION OF PUBLIC AGRICULTURAL LANDS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 24 OF COMMONWEALTH ACT NO. 141, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS "THE PUBLIC LAND ACT"
rows.title_short: Simplifying The Procedure In The Disposition Of Public Agricultural Lands
rows.abstract: Provides that the publication of notices of sale of lands sold under the provisions of this chapter shall be two (2) consecutive weeks instead of  six (6) consecutive weeks in the Official Gazette which shall be published in English, instead of English and Spanish. The threshold land value that will result in an exemption from the requirement of publication in the Official Gazette and in newspapers shall now be Fifty Thousand Pesos (P50,000.00), instead of Two Hundred Forty Pesos (P240.00). The date on which public biddings shall be held and the awards of the lands to disposed of shall be made thirty (30) days after the date of the notice of the sale, instead of sixty (60) days.

rows.title_full: AN ACT ADOPTING THE HIGHER PRESCRIBED PENALTY, INCLUDING DEATH, OF THE NATIONAL LAW OF AN ALIEN FOUND GUILTY OF TRAFFICKING DANGEROUS DRUGS AND OTHER SIMILAR SUBSTANCES, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 9165, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE êžŒCOMPREHENSIVE DANGEROUS DRUGS ACT OF 2002êžŒ
rows.abstract: Seeks to impose death penalty on foreign nationals who violates RA 9165 otherwise known as the Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002. States that should death penalty is not imposed by the national law of the offender, in addition to the penalties prescribed for the unlawful act committed, any alien who violates such provisions of this Act shall, after service of sentence, be deported immediately without further proceedings. Further states that the penalty of death, if applicable, shall be imposed despite the prohibition of the imposition of the death penalty in the Philippines.
